channel.title: AI Threat Watch: TW
channel.description: Verified case files located in TW.

item.title: [MEDIUM] UAT-11985 uses AI-assisted event lures for Google AitM phishing in Taiwan
item.description: Cisco Talos identified an APT spear-phishing campaign using AI-assisted lures and real-time Google adversary-in-the-middle phishing against Taiwan research affiliates. Target: Individuals at Taiwan research organizations. TW. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Taiwan ring used Starlink and deepfake faces to beat e-CNY checks and drain NT$200M
item.description: Taiwan's CIB and Thai police arrested a Taichung man backing a Chinese fraud network that built AI 3D face videos from brokered photos to pass e-CNY facial login and drain about NT$200 million from 55 victims. Target: Digital yuan app users in mainland China. TW. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Taichung indicts ring using ChatGPT scripts and deepfake Japanese police on video calls
item.description: A Taiwan-Japan-Malaysia ring wrote fraud scripts with ChatGPT and used AI face-swaps to appear as Japanese police when victims asked for video proof; about 18.65 million yen was laundered into USDT. Target: Japanese residents called from a Kuala Lumpur call centre. TW. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] UNK_DropPitch used ChatGPT to craft phishing and tooling against Taiwan's chip sector
item.description: A Chinese-language cluster tracked as UNK_DropPitch (UTA0388) wrote multilingual phishing emails and built remote-execution scripts and HTTPS traffic protection with ChatGPT while targeting Taiwan's chip industry. Target: Taiwanese investment and semiconductor firms, US academia. TW. Verification: confirmed.
